_description: EdTech Co (edtech_co) demo fixture for POST /v1/edtech_co/scan. Represents a realistic support-ticket record: a parent-contact-update ticket where the support agent pasted the student's raw APAAR ID into the free-text case note (an Exposure risk — a raw national identifier sitting in unstructured support-ticket text, the same shape of risk detection/README.md's support_tickets example already covers for Blinkit) while the ticket's structured metadata also carries student_name + school_name + dob together — individually low-signal fields that jointly re-identify a specific student (edtech_co's configured LINKAGE_RISK rule, org_config/configs/edtech_co/*.yaml).
_usage_note: See docs/onboarding.md and the Phase 7 report for how this single fixture is exercised against /scan (as two calls — text-only for the Exposure proof, fields-only for the Linkage proof — plus a combined text+fields call showing the same data still produces a real, correctly-classified violation either way). This split is a deliberate, documented consequence of /scan's own text+fields precedence rule (api/integration.py), not an artifact of this fixture.
